llc.formation_notes: Other SOS fees: name reservation $10, articles of amendment $100, certificate of good standing $20. An 'Annual Agent Fee' of $40 is also listed on the SOS schedule (applies when the SOS-listed service is used; not verified as mandatory).

annual_report.name: LLC Annual Certificate (18 O.S. 2055.2)
annual_report.due: each year on the anniversary date of the LLC's filing/registration
annual_report.late_penalty: no late fee listed; LLC ceases to be in good standing if not filed within 60 days after the due date

state_tax_on_llc.name: Oklahoma franchise tax
state_tax_on_llc.applies: repealed; never applied to LLCs taxed as partnerships/disregarded
state_tax_on_llc.notes: Franchise tax repealed by HB 1039X (2023) starting tax year 2024; tax year 2023 was the last year a return was required.

sources.title: Oklahoma Secretary of State - Fee Schedule
sources.quote: Articles of Organization - Oklahoma LLC 18 OS 2055 100.00 ... Annual Certificates - Oklahoma/Foreign LLC 18 OS 2055.2 25.00

sources.title: LLC Annual Certificate form
sources.quote: fails to file the annual certificate within sixty (60) days after the due date shall cease to be in good standing

sources.title: OTC: Franchise Tax Ends in Oklahoma (read via search result summary and FRX-200 listing)
sources.quote: tax year 2023 is the last year that franchise tax returns will be required to be filed

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Pass-Through Entity Tax Equity Act of 2019 (68 O.S. 2355.1P-1 to 2355.1P-4): partnerships and S corps may elect via Form 586 to pay Oklahoma income tax at entity level. Per-member rate (reported as top individual rate, 4.5% from 2026, and 6% for corporate members) not read on an official 2026 page.

sources.title: Enrolled HB 2764 (68 O.S. 2355)
sources.quote: a tax is hereby imposed upon the Oklahoma taxable income of every corporation ... in an amount equal to four percent (4%) thereof.

sources.title: OTC Form 586 Pass-through Entity Election (rev. 2025)
sources.quote: allows qualifying entities to elect to pay Oklahoma income tax at the entity level rather than having the income passed through

personal_exemption.notes: $1,000 per exemption (2026 OW-8-ES worksheet). Head of household uses the MFJ brackets and a $9,350 standard deduction (2025 Form 511 instructions).

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: none. HB 2764 adds automatic 0.25-point rate cuts after future State Board of Equalization certifications (effective Jan 1 after a February certification).

sources.title: Enrolled HB 2764 (2025), amending 68 O.S. 2355
sources.quote: (a) 0% tax on first $3,750.00 or part thereof, (b) 2.5% tax on the next $1,150.00 ... (d) 4.5% tax on the remainder.

sources.title: 2025 Oklahoma Form 511 packet
sources.quote: If your filing status is “single” or “married filing separate,” your Oklahoma standard deduction is $6,350.

estimated_tax.required_if: tax liability expected to exceed withholding by $500 or more and withholding below the smaller of 70% of current-year or 100% of prior-year tax
estimated_tax.notes: Safe harbor is 70% of current-year tax (not 90%). No underpayment interest if tax shown on return is under $1,000; underpayment interest 20% per annum. Farmers and estates exempt.

unemployment_2026.notes: OESC 2026: range 0.2% to 5.8%. Wage base cut from $28,200 (2025) by SB 911; OESC lists $24,400 for 2027.

notable: 2026 top rate cut to 4.5% (from 4.75%) and brackets collapsed to 0% / 2.5% / 3.5% / 4.5% by HB 2764 (https://www.oklegislature.gov/BillInfo.aspx?Bill=HB2764&Session=2500)
4.5% applies above only $7,200 of taxable income (single), so nearly all freelancers pay the top rate on most income (same source)
No franchise tax since tax year 2024 and no LLC entity tax; LLC costs are $100 formation + $25 annual certificate (https://www.sos.ok.gov/business/fees.aspx)
Estimated-tax safe harbor is 70% of current-year tax (https://oklahoma.gov/content/dam/ok/en/tax/documents/forms/individuals/current/OW-8-ES.pdf)
SUTA wage base dropped to $25,000 in 2026 (https://oklahoma.gov/content/dam/ok/en/oesc/images/misc/Employer-Improtant-Numbers-2026.pdf)
uncertain: Franchise tax repeal: the OTC newsroom page (2023-07-26) was identified via search; its text was seen only in search excerpts, not fetched directly.

Standard deduction $6,350/$12,700 read in the 2025 Form 511 packet; the 2026 packet is not yet published (amounts have been fixed by statute for years, so 2026 is very likely the same, but not read for 2026).
PTE election per-member rate for 2026 not read on an official source.
Did not check for a 2026-session law changing 2026 rates; the oksenate.gov press release on a tax package could not be fetched (JS redirect). HB 2764 rates are the enacted 2026 rates read today.
Annual Agent Fee $40 listed on the SOS fee schedule: applicability to a domestic LLC with its own registered agent not verified.
